column6: Say to my lord: this is what @varh[t3107.v1]{@wPN{Puzur-@wRN{Šulgi}} } @vart[t3107.v2,t3107.v1]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} @wPN{Puzur-@wDN{Marduk}} } @vart[t3107.v3,t3107.v1]{@varn{1 other ms. has instead:} @wPN{Puzur-@wDN{Numušda}} }, the commander of the fortress @wGN{Igi-ḫursaŋa}, your servant, says:

All the @varh[t3107.v4]{gold and silver } @vart[t3107.v5,t3107.v4]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} gold and lapis lazuli } @vart[t3107.v6,t3107.v4]{@varn{1 other ms. has instead:} silver and gold } that my lord has been fashioning for the @vart[t3107.v7,t3107.v7]{@varn{1 ms. adds:} great } gods -- is it not for his own life? For @varh[t3107.v8]{the life } @vart[t3107.v9,t3107.v8]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} the well-being } of the troops and his land, my king has built the great fortress @wGN{Igi-ḫursaŋa} for the people of his land, because of the wicked enemy.

And now the enemy troops have risen up. @varh[t3107.v10]{One } @vart[t3107.v11,t3107.v10]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} …… } man who had fled from me has been brought back. Having been caught, he has given me evidence of this, and @varh[t3107.v12]{went ahead } @vart[t3107.v13,t3107.v12]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} @q{“…… go!”}, and I went }.

I am also well-informed about the oracular signs concerning the enemy: the enemy has replenished his strength for battle. However, my strength is limited. I cannot strengthen the fortress further or @varh[t3107.v14]{guard it } @vart[t3107.v15,t3107.v14]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} guard the cities } against him.

As for the sector of @varh[t3107.v16]{@wPN{Šu-@wDN{Numušda}} } @vart[t3107.v17,t3107.v16]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} @wPN{Šu-@wDN{Marduk}} } @vart[t3107.v18,t3107.v16]{@varn{1 other ms. has instead:} @wPN{Puzur-@wDN{Numušda}} }, the ruler of @wSN{Ŋirilumtura}: five @fsux{nindan} lengths of it are cut off. As for the sector of @wPN{Lugal-melem}, the manager of the @varh[t3107.v19]{@wWN{Šegšeg} watercourse } @vart[t3107.v20,t3107.v19]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} city of @wSN{……} @noteref{the correct form of this name is not known} }: @varh[t3107.v21]{40 } @vart[t3107.v22,t3107.v21]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} 25 } @vart[t3107.v23,t3107.v21]{@varn{1 other ms. has instead:} 30 } @vart[t3107.v24,t3107.v21]{@varn{1 further ms. has instead:} 45 } @fsux{nindan} lengths of …… on top of it are no longer fixed. As for the sector of @wPN{Ka-kugani}, the ruler of the territory of @wGN{Murub}: 45 @fsux{nindan} lengths were destroyed when the opposite side was captured. As for the sector of @wPN{Tākil-ilišu}, the @varh[t3107.v25]{canal inspector } @vart[t3107.v26,t3107.v25]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} ruler } of the @wWN{Ab-gal} and @wWN{Me-@wDN{Enlila}} watercourses: 50 @fsux{nindan} lengths of the edge have been removed, and in the middle of it they collapsed.

Moreover it is not @varh[t3107.v27]{established } @vart[t3107.v28,t3107.v27]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} stated } @vart[t3107.v29,t3107.v27]{@varn{1 other ms. has instead:} known } when the enemy will pitch camp. @varh[t3107.v30]{Once the enemy is camped I will replenish my powers } @vart[t3107.v31,t3107.v30]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} The enemy will replenish his strength for battle }. @vart[t3107.v32,t3107.v32]{@varn{ 1 ms. adds:} I will fortify …… and ……. } His troops are camped among the hills.

If my lord agrees, @varh[t3107.v33]{may he send to me speedily } @vart[t3107.v34,t3107.v33]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} ……, let there be available } 7,200 soldiers as workmen who will carry baskets for me. @varh[t3107.v35]{May he send to me speedily } @vart[t3107.v36,t3107.v35]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} May there come, at my disposal, } 70 @varh[t3107.v37]{@wEN{Šimaškian} attendants …… } @vart[t3107.v38,t3107.v37]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} …… } @vart[t3107.v39,t3107.v37]{@varn{1 other ms. has instead:} …… }.

@varh[t3107.v40]{The enemy has devised their plans concerning this: @q{“I will resettle them”} } @vart[t3107.v41,t3107.v40]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} The enemy has devised his plans and has resettled the people } @vart[t3107.v42,t3107.v40]{@varn{1 other ms. has instead:} Plans concerning me have been devised: @q{“I will resettle them”} }. May it be known that, by night or by day the enemy's sins are forever grave.

I am the loyal servant of my lord @wRN{Šulgi}. @vart[t3107.v43,t3107.v43]{@varn{1 ms. adds:} …… which is not negligent. } Let this not be the death of me! May my lord know! @vart[t3107.v44,t3107.v44]{@varn{1 ms. adds:} It is urgent! }
